The '''refectories''' of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] were [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]-run dining halls consisting of kitchens, eating areas, and gardens. Located on several different levels of the Temple, the refectories varied in size and function, with some serving only specific meals. Each
[[Wikipedia:Refectory|refectory's]] kitchen had direct access to the foods stored within the Temple's [[Storage floor|storage level]].

==History==
Erected within the Temple Ziggurat, the refectories were destroyed and rebuilt several times in the Temple's long history, seeing completion in [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]] under the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In use for nearly a millennia after, the refectories serviced several generations of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] throughout the Order's service to the Republic.<ref name="SWCL">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref>

In [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]] the Temple was struck by a series of [[Incident at the Jedi Temple|robberies and attacks]] that put the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] on edge. While [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ali-Alann]] escorted a [[Unidentified Jedi clan|clan]] of [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|younglings]] to one of the dining halls via a horizontal [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolift]] car that ran over the [[Lake level|Lake Level]], the track became dislodge after sabotage by the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Xanatos]], causing the car filled with younglings to hang precariously over the lake five stories below. Below, a young [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Bant Eerin/Legends|Bant Eerin]] raced to save the children and with assistance from the full High Council, were able to get all of the younglings out of the car. The clan decided to walk to the dining hall after the ordeal.<ref name="Jedi Apprentice: The Captive Temple">''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Captive Temple]]''</ref>

Following the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Jedi [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] met in one of the Temple refectories before the [[Mission to Ord Cestus]] and shared a meal of [[thrantcill pâté]] and a plate of [[Hawk-bat/Legends|hawk-bat]] eggs, before taking an [[Air taxi/Legends|air taxi]] to [[Centralia Memorial Spaceport]].<ref name="The Cestus Deception">''[[The Cestus Deception]]''</ref> Later, Jedi [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] would pass [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Taria Damsin]] and [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] [[Biliril]] and [[Dorf]] after returning to the Temple from the [[Battle of Kothlis]]. While eating, [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] entered the hall and welcomed Skywalker back home. Yoda reminded the Jedi of their joint meeting with [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] the next morning and told Skywalker to get sleep.<ref name="CWG:S">''[[Clone Wars Gambit: Stealth]]''</ref>

Within the walled kitchen gardens of the Temple, the young Padawan [[Tallisibeth Enwandung-Esterhazy]] would burn herself with her low-power [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] in preparation for the [[Jedi Temple Apprentice Tournament|Apprentice Tournament]] of [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. During the tournament, Master [[Ilena Xan|Illena Xan]] held the final stage of the competition within one of the larger dining halls as the apprentices had complained that the other theaters weren't challenging or "real" enough.<ref name="YDR" />

A few months after the Tournament, the Republic was transformed into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the Temple was declared an enemy fortress under [[Contingency Orders for the Grand Army of the Republic: Order Initiation, Orders 1 Through 150|Contingency]] [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]]. The [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]], led by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], stormed the Temple and executed its occupants, damaging the Temple in the process. The Temple's dining halls were largely ruined, yet due to [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] occupation, at least one kitchen was maintained and debris had been cleared from its dining hall.<ref name="LJU">''[[The Last of the Jedi: Underworld]]''</ref>

Shortly after the fall of the Temple, ex-Jedi [[Ferus Olin]] and his companion, [[Trever Flume]], entered the Temple through one of the kitchen gardens in search of a rumored [[Storage floor|Jedi Prison]]. In one of the Towers the pair found the ruins of the garden of [[Yoland Fee]], whose products would be served to the many Jedi of the past. After discovering the prison to be an Imperial trap, the two rushed out of the bowels of the Temple and used an airlift from the Storage Level to get into one of the kitchens and flee the pursuing [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]].<ref name="LJU" /> Olin would later return to the Temple and gain access to the interior through an abandoned breakfast room near the base of the [[High Council Tower/Legends|High Council Tower]]. Olin would quietly reflect on the peace and serenity which had once filled the small chamber before the rise of the Empire.<ref name="LJR" />

The Temple sat in the hands of the Sith for several decades, guarded by the trusted [[Shadow stormtrooper/Legends|Shadow Troopers]] of the Empire. When [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] and Vader were slain, the Empire lost balance and was eventually [[Liberation of Coruscant (Galactic Civil War)|ousted]] from Coruscant by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] Coruscant was devastated by [[Terraforming/Legends|terraforming]], causing the Temple to crumble and reveal parts of the foundation.<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Enemy Lines II: Rebel Stand">''[[The New Jedi Order: Enemy Lines II: Rebel Stand]]''</ref> When the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] reclaimed the world, [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Cal Omas]], ordered the [[Reconstruction Authority]] to [[New Jedi Temple|rebuild]] the ancient edifice as a gift for the great sacrifices made by the [[New Jedi Order|reformed Order]] against the [[Yuuzhan Vong]].<ref name="DNI">''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]''</ref>

With the Order under the leadership of Grand Master [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], the Temple was reinhabited and the refectories once more filled with life. In [[43 ABY]] the Order was faced with a new threat when several Knights were stricken with an [[Force psychosis|enigmatic maddness]] and were declared subject to Alliance imprisonment. Acting Grand Master [[Kenth Hamner]] had rejected the requests of Chief [[Natasi Daala]] to hand over the ill Jedi, yet he was forced to comply with Daala's demand that all Jedi be [[Jedi supervisor|shadowed]] by a court appointed advisor. During the lunch hour of the Temple, [[Jedi High Council (New Jedi Order)|High Council]] member [[Kyp Durron]] entered one of the chambers and activated one of the swing-out [[Viewscreen/Legends|holoscreens]] on the wall; something that was usually forbidden. The display showed a news broadcast from the [[Galactic Courts of Justice/Legends|Galactic Courts of Justice Building]] detailing the overturning of the the [[Guilty by Association]] rider. Moments later, Masters Durron and [[Cilghal]] were summoned to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] Main Entrance to deal with a group of [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] members attempting to force their way into the Temple.<ref name="FOTJOT" />

Several days after the incident at the main entrance, Knight [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] had assisted the group [[Darkmeld]] smuggle the ill [[Seff Hellin]] into the Temple. Joined by former Jedi [[Tahiri Veila]], Solo met in the common dining hall for a cup of [[Caf/Legends|caf]], due to the chamber's relative emptiness and soothing atmosphere. Their peace was interrupted when Jaina's supervisor, [[Dab Hantaq]] appeared and upset Veila by his similar appearance to her former love, the deceased Jedi [[Anakin Solo]].<ref name="FOTJOT" />

==Layout==
Located throughout the Temple the refectories consisted of a kitchen and dining hall, and were serviced by supplies and ingredients from the Temple's Storage Level and the kitchen gardens.<ref name="YDR" /> Like most of the Temple these chambers were, while designed for beauty, maintained a sense of utilitarian purpose and were connected to the service corridors.<ref name="LJU" />

Each dining hall was filled with long, trestle tables that were flanked by benches; [[Holodisplay/Legends|holodisplays]] were hung along the pillared walls to show news from across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="FOTJOT" /> Refuse stations were located around the room for the return of dishes and utensils, and the disposal of any waste.<ref name="CWG:S" /> The halls were maintained by refectory [[Droid/Legends|droids]] capable of analyzing the content of the food trays. Hovering around the rooms, the droids would clear away any spills or forgotten dishes and dispose of any undesired waste.<ref name="YDR" />

In addition to the large dining halls, smaller breakfast rooms were in use around the structure for use by youngling clans during their early years of training. Small intimate chambers, Jedi Masters would visit the rooftop chambers and talk to the extremely young children. [[Transparisteel/Legends|Transparisteel]] windows along the walls could rise into the ceiling to let in fresh air on nice days, giving the younglings a chance to experience a cool breeze while they ate in the safety of the Temple.<ref name="LJR" />

The kitchens were large, capable of servicing over a hundred Jedi at a time. Large stoves and ovens lined the walls and preparation areas had datascreens from which supplies could be summoned from the Storage Level. Airlifts from the Storage Level would jettison up requested ingredients for use in certain recipes. Maintained by Jedi and non-[[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]] alike, the [[Temple employee]]s would work through the day to prepare the large meals needed to feed the Order's members.<ref name="LJU" /> Servicing the kitchens, kitchen gardens were a quiet area where the food for the Temple was grown. Master [[Yoland Fee]] maintained a garden in the the [[Tower of Reconciliation/Legends|Tower of Reconciliation]] where he grew herbs and spices for use in the kitchens.<ref name="YDR" />
